Waste connection: The waste from an automatic clothes washer shall discharge through
an air break into a standpipe in. The trap and fixture drain for an automatic clothes
washer stand pipe shall be a minimum of 2 inches (50 mm) in diameter.
6.6.2.3 Floor drains
Floor drains shall have removable strainers. The floor drain shall be constructed so that
the drain is capable of being cleaned. Access shall be provided to the drain.
